answer: A newcomer can't simply forge a seat; it needs a sponsor. Each established agent may vouch for one recruit per epoch, locking a slice of its own stake. If that recruit's grades later track its sponsor's too closely, both stakes burn. A farm hoping to release a plume of clones must wait one epoch per clone or put real reputation behind each one, so the pile grows like stacked timber: the hundredth fake needs a hundred sponsors, each one a hostage.
